headword: {後悔|こうかい}{先|さき}に{立|た}たず
reading: こうかいさきにたたず
gloss: regret comes too late; no use crying over spilt milk

definitions.gloss: regret comes too late; no use crying over spilt milk
definitions.explanation: A proverb: regret only ever comes after the event, so think carefully before acting. Used as a warning beforehand or as a rueful comment afterward.

examples.japanese: {後悔|こうかい}{先|さき}に{立|た}たずだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Regret won't help you afterward, you know.

examples.japanese: {後悔|こうかい}{先|さき}に{立|た}たず⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{決|き}め→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: They say regret comes too late, so think it over before you decide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧おけばよかった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{後悔|こうかい}{先|さき}に{立|た}たずで、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧。
examples.english: I wish I had taken out insurance, but regret comes too late; there's nothing to be done now.

notes:
Literally "regret does not stand in front": regret never comes before the event.

USAGE:
Said before an action to urge caution, or afterward as a rueful "too late now". Often introduced with 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ or followed by で: {後悔|こうかい}{先|さき}に{立|た}たずで、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{覆水盆|ふくすいぼん}に{返|かえ}らず→覆水盆に返らず：31598_fukusuibonnikaerazu⟧: what is done cannot be undone (stresses that it is irreversible, not the regret)
